title: Falcon Patrol
build: Remember crack, 'Falcon Patrol +5 and Highscoresaver 100%', highscore-saver only (no trainers)

exclude: BASIC ROM: $01 stays at $37, so the RAM underneath is never visible to the CPU
KERNAL ROM: every symbol here is a KERNAL entry point the game calls, not the game's own bytes
extra: terrain map: 256 world columns by 8 landscape rows, reached only through a computed pointer so nothing references it by address

regions: Remember's front end: menu, trainers and the instruction screen
sprite blocks $80-$9F: the player's seven yaw frames, the eight explosion frames, the exhaust plume and the two enemy attitude sets
the saved high-score table, five entries of five digits and twelve name characters
the title tune: six note tables, a SID register image and the note lengths
the player's attitude bank, two sets of five frames
status-panel template, five rows of forty
the terrain map and the six bases
SID register images for the effects
